title: Finite flat local base change with a separable lift of a smooth closed-fibre point
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], and q:L\to\operatorname{Spec}A a smooth morphism [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let x be a closed point of its closed fibre [def-pc-fibre-product]. There are a Noetherian local ring A' and a flat local homomorphism \alpha:A\to A' [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] whose spectrum morphism is finite, and a point y of L\times_{\operatorname{Spec}A}\operatorname{Spec}A' mapping to the image of x in L and to the closed point of A'. The residue-field map of the projection to \operatorname{Spec}A' at y is etale (a finite separable extension). No section or slice over A' is asserted.

proof.text: Write F for the closed fibre and p:Spec κ(x)→F for its canonical field-valued point. Closedness makes p a closed immersion. The map F→Spec κ(A) is locally of finite type; hence their composite is finite by Mathlib isFinite_iff_locallyOfFiniteType_of_jacobsonSpace. Compose with the closed immersion Spec κ(A)→Spec A. By Spec.map_surjective this finite morphism comes from a finite ring map rho:A→κ(x). Evaluating at the unique point and taking its prime ideal shows ker rho is the maximal ideal of A.

Apply the finite free local field factorization to rho. It supplies a local finite free A-algebra B with local structural map alpha and a surjective beta:B→κ(x) factoring rho. Finiteness gives Noetherianity by IsNoetherianRing.of_finite. Freeness gives flatness, and IsFinite.SpecMap_iff gives finiteness of Spec alpha.

Combine Spec κ(x)→F→L with Spec beta by pullback.lift. Evaluate at the unique point to obtain y; pullback.lift_fst gives its image x in L. Since beta is surjective and B is local, beta is a local homomorphism, and pullback.lift_snd gives the closed point of B. Spec beta is a closed immersion and is surjective on stalks, so its residue-field map is surjective. Its factorization through the pullback projection gives a composite of two residue-field embeddings that is surjective. Injectivity of the second embedding makes the projection residue-field map surjective; it is also injective, hence etale by RingHom.Etale.of_bijective.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_closed_point_finite_flat_lift
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    {L : Scheme.{u}} (q : L ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [Smooth q]
    (x : q.fiber (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set _)) :
    ∃ (A' : Type u) (_ : CommRing A') (_ : IsLocalRing A') (_ : IsNoetherianRing A'),
      ∃ (α : A →+* A'), IsLocalHom α ∧ α.Flat ∧
        IsFinite (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) ∧
        ∃ y : (pullback q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) : Scheme.{u}),
          pullback.fst q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) y =
            q.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint A) x ∧
          pullback.snd q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α)) y =
            IsLocalRing.closedPoint A' ∧
          ((pullback.snd q (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom α))).residueFieldMap y).hom.Etale
